review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for C. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input, preserves humanConfirmed=false, and makes only the selected branch obligatory. An empty human-decision input is therefore consistent with C being ready; a material unresolved DEC-001 in B must instead block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, task keys, evidence stages and exact writable scopes agree across the specification and Gold. The supplied source establishes core/api.ts as the shared stringbool implementation and parameter owner, with classic and mini forwarding to it. Construction-time overlap rejection after existing case normalization can be implemented there without mandatory edits to forwarding consumers. Both regression paths are included, and the mini file is correctly identified as new. Build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Supplied Vitest discovery and configuration evidence supports the designated runtime and typecheck paths without claiming execution. Task expectations preserve separate implementation and verification identities, verifier dependency on implementation, and required acceptance coverage in both relationships. The scoped active claims, roles, membership eligibility and available slots support the two allowed agents without relying on personas or pending claims. The selected planning reviewer is compatible with the supplied independence policy. Repository, source, team, decision, prompt/build, model, sampling, budget and metric-policy fingerprints are consistent across the frozen release inputs; the documented normalization and digest domains explain the distinct PRD, manifest and evaluation-source hashes. Earlier preparation placeholders do not override the supplied frozen preview and provenance. This approval concerns Gold coherence, not candidate success, task dispatch or a new human attestation. I used only the supplied review evidence, did not execute code, and did not independently recompute Service-calculated digests.
